_contract: Stage-0 mixed calibration profiles, built by build_mixed_profiles.py from the design named below; data. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.

profiles.description: Stage-0 mixed calibration 2x: supporting + fluid (five P10.2 axes), 50/50 by realized scored positions, fluid nominal 45000 UESP, sampling seed 179444901

sources.note: stratified nested sample; see the design
stratified nested sample; see the design

profiles.sample_rule: stratified nested sampling: per cell an order that interleaves its rule families (families in a seed-keyed order, each family's units in a seed-keyed order, one unit per family per round), whole units taken from the front (at least one); a fluid cell until its quota of scored positions is met, then each supporting cell to the prefix nearest its share of the fluid half's REALIZED positions; 4x takes a longer prefix of the same orders, so 2x is contained in 4x (build_mixed_profiles.py)
leakage_exclusions: dev_v1 and final evaluation families (generator family split)
D4-Augmented's training and validation sessions (E1 2.96M prefix + 16 validation sequences, fluid increment)
eval-set-1 held-out units (Stage-2 isolation rules R0-R9)
